# opnsense_ids_settings (Resource)

Intrusion detection settings (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Administration ▸ Settings**): Suricata mode, interfaces, home networks, detection profile and logging. Rulesets are enabled with `opnsense_ids_ruleset`. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `ids_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_ids_settings.this
  id = "ids_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_ids_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  mode          = "pcap"
  interfaces    = ["wan"]
  home_networks = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
  syslog_alerts = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alert_logrotate` (String) Alert log rotation: `W0D23` (weekly) or `D0` (daily).
- `alert_save_logs` (Number) Number of rotated alert logs to keep (1-1000).
- `default_packet_size` (Number) Default packet size (82-65535), empty for the Suricata default.
- `detect_profile` (String) Detection profile: empty for the default, `low`, `medium`, `high` or `custom`.
- `detect_toclient_groups` (Number) toclient-groups of the custom detection profile.
- `detect_toserver_groups` (Number) toserver-groups of the custom detection profile.
- `divert_listeners` (Number) Number of divert listeners (1-256), divert mode only.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Suricata intrusion detection service.
- `eve_http_dump_all_headers` (String) Headers dumped in HTTP logs: empty for none, `request`, `response` or `both`.
- `eve_http_enabled` (Boolean) Log HTTP transactions to the eve log.
- `eve_http_extended` (Boolean) Extended HTTP logging.
- `eve_tls_custom` (Set of String) Custom TLS fields to log, e.g. `["sni", "ja4"]`.
- `eve_tls_enabled` (Boolean) Log TLS handshakes to the eve log.
- `eve_tls_extended` (Boolean) Extended TLS logging.
- `eve_tls_session_resumption` (Boolean) Log TLS session resumptions.
- `home_networks` (Set of String) Networks treated as `$HOME_NET`.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to inspect, e.g. `["wan"]`.
- `log_payload` (Boolean) Include the packet payload in eve alerts.
- `mode` (String) Capture mode: `pcap` (IDS only), `netmap` or `divert` (IPS, allows drop actions).
- `pattern_matcher` (String) Multi-pattern matcher: empty for the default, `ac`, `ac-ks` or `hs`.
- `promiscuous` (Boolean) Put the interfaces in promiscuous mode, needed for VLANs in netmap mode.
- `syslog_alerts` (Boolean) Send alerts to the system log in fast_log format.
- `syslog_eve` (Boolean) Send alerts to the system log in eve format.
- `update_cron` (String) UUID of the cron job that updates the rules.
- `verbosity` (String) Log verbosity: empty for the default, `v`, `vv`, `vvv` or `vvvv`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ids_settings`.
